ReviewI.corrected_shell_vector_limit.{u_1, u_2} {X : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [MeasurableSpace X] (mu : Measure X)
  (p : E → X → ℝ) (hp : ReviewM.PositivePartition p) (wide narrow full : X → ℂ) (sandwich regularized : ℕ → X → ℂ)
  (hwide : Integrable wide mu) (hnarrow : Integrable narrow mu) (hfull : Integrable full mu)
  (hsand : ∀ (n : ℕ), Integrable (sandwich n) mu) (hreg : ∀ (n : ℕ), Integrable (regularized n) mu)
  (hlim : Tendsto (fun n => ∫ (x : X), ‖sandwich n x - full x‖ ∂mu) atTop (𝓝 0)) :
  Tendsto
    (fun n =>
      ∑' (e : E),
        ‖((ReviewI.masked mu (fun x => ↑(p e x)) wide - ReviewI.masked mu (fun x => ↑(p e x)) narrow -
                ReviewI.masked mu (fun x => ↑(p e x)) fun x => sandwich n x - regularized n x) +
              ReviewI.masked mu (fun x => ↑(p e x)) fun x => narrow x - regularized n x) -
            ReviewI.masked mu (fun x => ↑(p e x)) fun x => wide x - full x‖)
    atTop (𝓝 0)
